mapper.select: select s.id::text as id, s.title, s.description, s.category as category_label, s.thumbnail_url as thumbnail_url, coalesce( cast(round((sp.learned_items::numeric / nullif(sp.total_items, 0)) * 100) as integer), 0 ) as progress, (select count(*) from packs p where p.series_id = s.id and p.is_published = true) as pack_count, exists( select 1 from series_subscriptions ss where ss.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and ss.series_id = s.id and ss.status = 'active' ) as subscribed from series s left join series_progress sp on sp.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and sp.series_id = s.id where s.is_published = true order by s.created_at asc

select s.id::text as id, s.title, s.description, s.category as category_label, s.thumbnail_url as thumbnail_url, coalesce( cast(round((sp.learned_items::numeric / nullif(sp.total_items, 0)) * 100) as integer), 0 ) as progress, (select count(*) from packs p where p.series_id = s.id and p.is_published = true) as pack_count, true as subscribed from series_subscriptions ss join series s on s.id = ss.series_id left join series_progress sp on sp.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and sp.series_id = s.id where ss.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and ss.status = 'active' and s.is_published = true order by ss.subscribed_at desc

select s.id::text as id, s.title, s.description, s.category as category_label, s.thumbnail_url as thumbnail_url, coalesce( cast(round((sp.learned_items::numeric / nullif(sp.total_items, 0)) * 100) as integer), 0 ) as progress from series s left join series_progress sp on sp.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and sp.series_id = s.id where s.id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid) and s.is_published = true limit 1

select p.id::text as id, p.title, p.description, p.order_index, ( select count(*) from learning_items li where li.pack_id = p.id and li.is_published = true ) as item_count, ( select count(*) from learning_items li where li.pack_id = p.id and li.is_published = true and exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = li.id and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at > now() ) ) as completed_item_count, ( select count(*) from learning_items li where li.pack_id = p.id and li.is_published = true and not exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = li.id and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at > now() ) ) as remaining_item_count, ( select li.id::text from learning_items li where li.pack_id = p.id and li.is_published = true and not exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = li.id and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at > now() ) order by li.order_index asc limit 1 ) as first_item_id from packs p where p.series_id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid) and p.is_published = true order by p.order_index asc

select li.id::text from learning_items li where li.pack_id = cast(#{packId} as uuid) and li.is_published = true and not exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = li.id and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at > now() ) order by li.order_index asc limit 1

select li.id::text as id, li.pack_id::text as pack_id, li.source_text, li.target_text, li.nuance_note, li.example_sentence, li.example_translation, li.order_index as order_index, case when #{mode} = 'study' then greatest( 1, ( select count(*) from learning_items same_pack where same_pack.pack_id = li.pack_id and same_pack.is_published = true and same_pack.order_index <= li.order_index and not exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = same_pack.id and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at > now() ) ) ) else li.order_index end as current, ( case when #{mode} = 'study' then ( select count(*) from learning_items same_pack where same_pack.pack_id = li.pack_id and same_pack.is_published = true and not exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = same_pack.id and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at > now() ) ) else ( select count(*) from learning_items same_pack where same_pack.pack_id = li.pack_id and same_pack.is_published = true ) end ) as total from learning_items li where li.id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) and li.is_published = true limit 1

with current_item as ( select li.id, li.pack_id, li.order_index from learning_items li where li.id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) ), unresolved as ( select li.id, li.order_index from learning_items li join current_item ci on ci.pack_id = li.pack_id where li.is_published = true and not exists ( select 1 from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.learning_item_id = li.id and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at > now() ) ), next_after as ( select u.id::text as next_id from unresolved u join current_item ci on true where u.order_index > ci.order_index order by u.order_index asc limit 1 ), first_unresolved as ( select u.id::text as next_id from unresolved u order by u.order_index asc limit 1 ) select coalesce( (select next_id from next_after), (select next_id from first_unresolved) )

with candidates as ( select li.id::text as next_id, case when li.id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) then 1 else 0 end as is_current, coalesce(rs.next_review_at, now()) as next_review_at from review_schedules rs join learning_items li on li.id = rs.learning_item_id where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at <= now() ) select next_id from candidates order by is_current asc, next_review_at asc limit 1

with candidates as ( select f.learning_item_id::text as next_id, case when f.learning_item_id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) then 1 else 0 end as is_current, f.created_at from favorites f where f.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) ) select next_id from candidates order by is_current asc, created_at desc limit 1

with current_item as ( select li.id, li.pack_id from learning_items li where li.id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid) ), random_other as ( select li.id::text as next_id from learning_items li join current_item ci on ci.pack_id = li.pack_id where li.is_published = true and li.id <> ci.id order by random() limit 1 ), random_any as ( select li.id::text as next_id from learning_items li join current_item ci on ci.pack_id = li.pack_id where li.is_published = true order by random() limit 1 ) select coalesce( (select next_id from random_other), (select next_id from random_any) )
select li.id::text from learning_items li where li.pack_id = cast(#{packId} as uuid) and li.is_published = true order by random() limit 1

select li.id::text as item_id, li.source_text, li.target_text, s.title as series_title, p.title as pack_title from favorites f join learning_items li on li.id = f.learning_item_id join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id join series s on s.id = p.series_id where f.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) order by f.created_at desc

select li.id::text as item_id, li.source_text, s.title as series_title, li.example_sentence as context_text from review_schedules rs join learning_items li on li.id = rs.learning_item_id join packs p on p.id = li.pack_id join series s on s.id = p.series_id where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at <= now() order by rs.next_review_at asc

select (select count(*) from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at <= now()) as due_count, (select count(distinct ua.learning_item_id) from user_answers ua where ua.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and coalesce(ua.is_correct, false) = true) as reviewed_distinct_count

select to_char(day_series.day, 'DY') as day_label, coalesce(count(rl.id), 0) as review_count from ( select generate_series(current_date - interval '6 day', current_date, interval '1 day')::date as day ) day_series left join review_logs rl on rl.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rl.reviewed_at::date = day_series.day group by day_series.day order by day_series.day asc
